submitted.rationale: The XRD patterns at indices 5, 12, 19 and 25 all show the same main phase, which I tentatively read as a trirutile-type structure. Indices 5 and 12 are single-phase. Index 19 shows a second phase starting, and at index 25 it is strong. EQE at 2.1 eV: index 12 (Ni0.55Sb0.45) = 0.0203%, index 7 (Ni0.71Sb0.29) = 0.0077%, index 19 (Ni0.34Sb0.66) = 0.0013%. Across these three points the peak falls around index 12, the single-phase Ni-rich/intermediate region. Indices 9-15 were not measured, so the true optimum could be a neighbouring composition.
